gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-psalter-pa: Bevellier cuts its letters like stencil work, flat and wiry. Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi, a plain sans with gaping e mouths and low capitals, gives that tight, graceful heading a friendly, unfussy partner.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Wide glass-porthole counters make this body text feel open and current. Noto Sans Rejang keeps every letter distinct, while Bevellier, drawn like bent neon tubing, brings the graceful, tightly spaced display flourish.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-runic: Noto Sans Runic has a big x-height and open curves that never fold back on themselves, so it feels modern and plain. Bevellier's matched curves and stems add a graceful stencil edge.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-samaritan: Bevellier is sophisticated, stencil-flat and tightly spaced, with diagonals that match its stems. Noto Sans Samaritan, a plain sans with hefty lowercase and daylight inside every curve, answers with a friendlier, sturdier build.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-saurashtra: Noto Sans Saurashtra keeps its capitals barely taller than the lowercase, and its counters stay connected to the outside. Bevellier's monoline stencil grace makes it feel wonderfully crisp beside it.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-sc: Bevellier draws joins as thick as its strokes, giving a graceful, stencil-cut look with tight spacing. Noto Sans SC, with chalky open curves, makes the text feel smooth and modern.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-sharada: Sophisticated and flat-cut, Bevellier has no thick-thin flicker to catch the eye, just single-weight strokes and tight spacing. And Noto Sans Sharada, with open c forms and bulky lowercase, supplies sturdy, friendly bulk beneath it.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-siddham: Bevellier's single-weight, stencil-cut strokes and bowls drawn at stem thickness look like bent wire, graceful and tightly packed. Noto Sans Siddham, a sans-serif with a large central band, deserves a comfortable text size so its open s shows.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-sinhala: Noto Sans Sinhala lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through each line, with curve endings that never crowd. Bevellier does stencil elegance in big display letters, but the body handles the sustained text.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Noto Sans Soyombo has a sizable x-height for screens and curved letters with wide, unclosed mouths. Bevellier, with its stencil-flat strokes and no tapering, sits above it as a graceful, tightly spaced display.
